status: Value-free inventory and selective hybrid design; offline source/ledger checks; runtime implementation and rollout remain #99-#101
inclusionRule: Supplied environment inputs, credential/target CLI selectors, runbook and platform-injected credentials, and deliberately refused names. Excludes source policy keys, workflow-internal state, constants and artifact paths unless they carry or select credentials.
resolution: For each entry, use its profile, explicit consumers file paths, then overrides. Each cited file contains the name (without a trailing * for refused prefixes). Runbook category names are actual source phrases; notes disambiguate their meaning. References establish source use/declaration/refusal, not live deployment access.
